senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. פְּגַר II) lax, decaying, corpse.—Pl. פְּגָרִים.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:16">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 15:11">Gen. XV, 11</cite>) <he>לכשיעשו בניך פ׳ בלא וכ׳</he> when thy children are lax bodies, without sinews and bones (bare of good deeds and character), thy merit shall stand by them. Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ top <he>ראו פִיגְרֵי … וכולם פ׳ מתים וכ׳</he> they saw the bodies of sinful men …, and all of them were dead bodies cast out at the shore; a. e.
